## Load

![Load icon](../../assets/icons/LoadComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Load` · GUID `c07304be-fe9c-4810-ba1d-1cac1710c386` · exposure primary

A load: design value in its basis and a fraction schedule. Magnitudes are people, W, or m³/h.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Type | `T` | Text | item | no | – | Load type: Occupancy, Lighting, ElectricEquipment, GasEquipment, DomesticHotWater, Ventilation, Infiltration. |
| Basis | `B` | Text | item | no | – | Basis: PerFloorArea, PerPerson, Absolute, PerExteriorWallArea, AirChangesPerHour. |
| Value | `V` | Number | item | no | – | Design value in the basis' unit. |
| Schedule | `Sch` | [Schedule](info.md#schedule) | item | no | – | A fraction schedule. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Load | `L` | [Load](info.md#load) | item | The load. |

## Program Preset

![Program Preset icon](../../assets/icons/ProgramPresetComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Preset` · GUID `56ca1eba-abed-4dbb-a9a7-09d8b5806231` · exposure primary

Loads, conditioning and setpoints, and window-to-wall ratio for one space type.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Name | `N` | Text | item | no | – | Preset name; descriptive only (reports, provenance, messages), never used for matching. |
| Space Type | `ST` | Text | item | no | – | Space type: DwellingUnit, Corridor, Stair, Core, Lobby, Service, Mechanical, Other, Mixed, Office, Retail, Mall, Kitchen, Dining, OperatingTheatre, CleanCorridor, DirtyCorridor, ClinicalSupport, CareBedroom, CareCommunal, ActivityHall. |
| Loads | `L` | [Load](info.md#load) | list | yes | – | Loads; at most one per type and basis. |
| Conditioned | `Cond` | Boolean | item | no | `True` | Whether the space is conditioned. Conditioned spaces need both setpoints. |
| Heating | `H` | [Schedule](info.md#schedule) | item | yes | – | Heating setpoint, a temperature schedule (°C); conditioned spaces only. |
| Cooling | `C` | [Schedule](info.md#schedule) | item | yes | – | Cooling setpoint, a temperature schedule (°C); conditioned spaces only. |
| WWR | `WWR` | Number | item | no | – | Window-to-wall ratio in [0, 1) used by the plan generator for every exterior wall. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Preset | `P` | [Program Preset](info.md#program-preset) | item | The program preset. |

## Schedule

![Schedule icon](../../assets/icons/ScheduleComponent.png)

Component · nickname `Sch` · GUID `1be96980-e9eb-4636-9ce6-4e5b6a301d1f` · exposure primary

An 8760-hour schedule from a 24-hour weekday and weekend profile (holidays not modelled).

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Name | `N` | Text | item | no | – | Schedule name. |
| Kind | `K` | Text | item | no | `Fraction` | Value meaning: Fraction, Temperature. |
| Weekday | `Wd` | Number | list | no | – | 24 hourly values for Monday to Friday. |
| Weekend | `We` | Number | list | no | – | 24 hourly values for Saturday and Sunday. |
| First Day | `D` | Text | item | no | `Monday` | Weekday of 1 January. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Schedule | `Sch` | [Schedule](info.md#schedule) | item | The schedule. |

## Any Program Preset

![Any Program Preset icon](../../assets/icons/AnyProgramPresetParameter.png)

Parameter · nickname `AnyP` · GUID `24bc6a12-ad06-4c25-bc9d-4e8318b8744c` · exposure primary

Casts a program preset of any space type to an any-program preset: the same name, loads, schedules, conditioning, setpoints, and WWR, without a space type. Wire it into any preset input of any plan generator; the zones keep that input's space type, and the plan records the use in its provenance (AnyProgramPreset.&lt;Input&gt;).
